result:
I've written the round 377 task. Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 377 finishes PERF-11c-iii-c1.

**What happened in round 376:** A applied my frozen sketch exactly, then stopped and asked for two rulings. C reported BLOCKED with no bugs, but several checks were not run (perf, mutants, part of the browser rows), so `browserVerified` is false. The gate was skipped and nothing was published. The starting point is still `6b11be7` plus A's uncommitted changes (6 modified files and the new doc 243). Because of that, nothing moved to done.

**My rulings:**
- **TC10 timeout:** A misread it. A measured it against vitest's default 5 s limit, but the test sits inside a block that sets a 15 s timeout. Every measurement is 11–21% of 15 s, so it needs no change. I closed it as an info note. The advisor first suggested raising the timeout; the file itself settled it.
- **Reviewer M1 (Medium), accepted:** no test proved the Transport stays un-rendered when an edit leaves the Undo/Redo labels unchanged. I added a new test row, RB-LEAF4b: toggle Master Mute twice, and on the second toggle all four Transport parts render 0 times. I ran it on a scratch copy of A's tree:
  - the 140 related test files pass (2,201 tests);
  - the shuffled run passes 41/41;
  - typecheck and Biome are clean.

  A deliberate break that makes `undo` change identity on every edit turns only the new row red. The existing RB-LEAF4 stays green, so the gap was real.
- **Reviewer M2 (Low):** the one-frame expiry assumes React commits synchronously. Nothing on that path uses a transition today (0 hits), and a check in the claims script will catch it if that changes. No extra test.
- **Reviewer Lows L1–L3** went to the deferred polish list. The architecture note is recorded as a signal for the open frontend-architect checkpoint and is not scheduled.

**Round 377:**
- **A** may touch only two files. It applies a one-row patch to `render-budget.test.tsx`, which must then match the new sha list for all six files. It also updates doc 243: line 4 becomes `C round 377 PASS`, plus the new row, the new break test and the rulings.
- **C** does a full run. Every browser row runs fresh at 1440×900 and 1280×720; round-376 results are only reference values, never a substitute. That covers:
  - the 140 related test files plus the shuffled run;
  - all 11 break tests;
  - both perf specs;
  - the leaf probe;
  - the range and Loop steps that weren't run before;
  - the anonymous auth check;
  - a smoke run that now includes clicking Master Mute twice;
  - the docs check.

**Next:** after C passes, rounds 376 and 377 go to the gate together. The 3-day regression round is due at the first planning on or after 2026-11-08 (most likely round 378's planning). Then PERF-11c-iii-c2 (LoopBrace and MarkerRow).

I changed no app code. I deleted my scratch copy after saving its outputs; the patch file recreates it. The advisor was available and I consulted it twice: before choosing the approach and before finishing. Its last review caught three conflicting instructions about browser evidence in the task; I fixed them to the single rule above.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop`:
- current-task.md
- tasks/round-376.md
- b-round-376.md
- b-next.json
- backlog.json
- feature-status.md
- b-round-376/
